target_text.pathway_activity: x12 gates the first layer. On the three samples with negative x12 all twenty units return exactly zero, while the five samples with positive x12 open the layer broadly. The sample sitting just above the boundary opens it only faintly, and the response strengthens steadily for samples further into the positive half-space.
target_text.feature_sensitivity: x12 is a binary switch on the whole pathway, and its magnitude matters only on the positive side, where it sets the overall strength of the response while the other coordinates shape its pattern. On the negative side the hidden state is independent of every input.
target_text.representational_structure: The closed samples collapse to the origin in the first layer and to one shared bias pattern in the second, forming a single point. The open samples spread across a multi-dimensional region. The faint boundary sample lies close to that shared point in the second layer, making it the open sample least distinguishable from the closed group.
target_text.functional_mapping: On the closed side all three outputs are pinned to the same constants regardless of the targets, which vary widely there. On the open side, including the faint boundary sample, the predictions follow the targets closely, so nearly all of the error lies in the negative half-space of x12.

target_text.pathway_activity: All nine units are active on every sample, though a few come close to zero on individual samples. Activity is shared across overlapping groups of units rather than concentrated in a few, so each sample produces a distinct, fully populated pattern.
target_text.feature_sensitivity: Two input directions drive the layer: one combining x0 and x2, and a stronger one contrasting x3 against x5. Neither direction takes over completely, while x1 and x4 have no consistent influence on any unit.
target_text.representational_structure: The hidden states occupy a two-dimensional sheet with its widest spread along the x3/x5 contrast. The four samples sit far apart on it, with no collapse or overlap.
target_text.functional_mapping: Both outputs keep the sign and the ordering of their targets on every sample, but their amplitude is heavily damped. The map is a near-uniform shrinkage: the pattern across samples is preserved exactly, and the samples with the largest target magnitudes show the biggest absolute shortfall.

target_text.pathway_activity: All fifteen units are live, but which ones fire is decided entirely by x8. Units 0, 2, 4, 6, 7, 9, 11 and 13 strengthen as x8 increases, and units 1, 3, 5, 8, 10, 12 and 14 strengthen as it decreases. At either extreme of x8, most of the opposing family shuts off.
target_text.feature_sensitivity: x8 alone drives every hidden unit. The other eleven coordinates leave the activations unchanged, including x3, x4, x9 and x11, which the targets depend on.
target_text.representational_structure: Hidden states lie along a single curved path parameterised by x8. Samples are ordered by their x8 value, and the handover between the two families bends the path; the geometry carries no trace of any other coordinate.
target_text.functional_mapping: Output 0, whose target is mostly x8, is tracked closely. Outputs 1 and 2 follow only the x8 part of their targets and miss the x3 and x9 parts, so they agree with their targets in sign on some samples and disagree on others. Output 3, built from coordinates the network never sees, is essentially flat.

target_text.pathway_activity: Seventeen of the twenty-four units fire on every sample and seven (units 1, 5, 9, 12, 16, 20 and 23) never fire. The active units are rigid multiples of one shared intensity, so despite its width the layer conveys a single signal.
target_text.feature_sensitivity: The shared intensity rises with x2 and x5. Other coordinates have no consistent influence, so the network is blind to every input direction except that one projection.
target_text.representational_structure: All seven hidden vectors lie on a single ray from the origin, ordered by intensity. The layer's covariance has only one non-trivial direction, and the remaining dimensions are unused.
target_text.functional_mapping: The prediction is an increasing affine function of the intensity. It follows the target where the target is driven by x2 and x5, but the target also depends on x7, which the intensity ignores, so the prediction misses part of the target's spread and misorders samples where x7 is large.

target_text.pathway_activity: Eleven of the fourteen first-layer units respond on every sample and units 2, 7 and 12 never fire. The second layer repeats the pattern with seven of its nine units responding, and in both layers the responding units are fixed multiples of one per-sample intensity.
target_text.feature_sensitivity: The intensity rises with x6 alone; every other input direction is invisible to both hidden layers.
target_text.representational_structure: Both layers lie exactly on rays from the origin, with the five samples ordered along them by x6. The second layer maps the first ray onto another ray and adds no dimensions.
target_text.functional_mapping: Both outputs are affine in the intensity. Output 0 follows the x6 part of its target and misses the rest, while output 1 barely moves and runs against a target built from x9, a coordinate the network never sees.

target_text.pathway_activity: The sign of x5 gates the layer: on the two samples with negative x5 all thirteen units are exactly zero, and on the four samples with positive x5 the layer opens, more strongly the further x5 lies above zero.
target_text.feature_sensitivity: x5 decides whether the pathway exists and how strongly it responds; the other coordinates only reshape activity among the open units, and on the closed side none of them matters.
target_text.representational_structure: Both closed samples coincide at the origin, while the open samples spread outward in proportion to x5, so the batch splits into a single point and a separate cloud.
target_text.functional_mapping: On the open side both predictions follow their targets closely. On the closed side each output falls back to one constant, which leaves output 0 on the wrong side of zero for both closed samples.

target_text.pathway_activity: Ten of the eighteen units never activate on any sample, a dead corridor covering more than half the layer. The eight live units form two opposed families: units 1, 7, 12 and 15 strengthen as x3 increases, while units 3, 6, 9 and 13 strengthen as it decreases.
target_text.feature_sensitivity: x3 alone steers both live families. The other coordinates leave the live units unchanged, and anything the dead units might have carried never reaches the output.
target_text.representational_structure: The batch traces a thin, one-dimensional bent path through the live units, ordered by x3, with the bend where the families hand over. The ten dead coordinates contribute no separation.
target_text.functional_mapping: The prediction is a monotone function of x3, but the target also depends on another coordinate the live pathway never sees. The sample with the highest x3 is predicted highest although its target sits near zero, and the sample with the largest target is under-predicted.

target_text.pathway_activity: All eleven units stay active on every sample, with no dormant units. Units 0, 2, 5 and 9 strengthen as the main hidden axis rises and units 1, 3, 6 and 8 weaken, while units 4, 7 and 10 lean on a weaker second axis.
target_text.feature_sensitivity: The main axis follows x1 and the weaker second axis follows x7; no single coordinate takes over the layer completely.
target_text.representational_structure: The first-layer activations form a two-dimensional sheet with its widest spread along x1. The five samples sit well apart on it, with no collapse or overlap.
target_text.functional_mapping: All three outputs keep the sign and the exact ordering of their targets on every sample, but each is damped to a small fraction of its target's amplitude. The output map acts as a uniform shrinkage, so the largest-magnitude targets show the largest absolute shortfall.

target_text.pathway_activity: All ten units are live, and their on/off pattern is set entirely by x6. Units 0, 2, 4, 6 and 8 open as x6 increases and units 1, 3, 5, 7 and 9 open as it decreases, so the most negative and most positive samples are carried by opposite families.
target_text.feature_sensitivity: x6 alone drives every hidden unit; the remaining coordinates, including x3, which the second target depends on, leave the activations unchanged.
target_text.representational_structure: The hidden states lie along a single curved path parameterised by x6, bending where the two families hand over. Samples with equal x6 would be indistinguishable however much their other coordinates differ.
target_text.functional_mapping: Output 0, whose target is essentially x6, is tracked closely. Output 1 follows only the x6 part of its target and misses the larger x3 part, so it agrees with its target in sign on some samples and disagrees on others.

target_text.pathway_activity: x13 gates the first layer. On the three samples with negative x13 all sixteen units return exactly zero, and on the four samples with positive x13 fourteen units respond while units 4 and 11 never fire at all. In the second layer two units are dormant on every sample and the rest show one fixed bias pattern across the closed samples.
target_text.feature_sensitivity: x13 acts as a switch on the whole pathway and as its overall gain on the open side, where the other coordinates shape the pattern of activity. On the closed side no input reaches the hidden state.
target_text.representational_structure: The closed samples collapse to the origin in the first layer and to a single shared point in the second. The open samples spread across a multi-dimensional region whose distance from the origin grows with x13.
target_text.functional_mapping: On the open side all four predictions follow their targets closely. On the closed side every output is pinned to one constant while the targets differ widely, so nearly all of the error lies in the negative half-space of x13.
